entities.summary: Ya'akov Dov "Ketzele" Katz is an Israeli politician. He led the National Union party from 2008 to 2012, for whom he was a member of the Knesset, and is also the executive director of Beit El yeshiva Center Institutions and Arutz Sheva. He is a settler leader. Ya'akov Katz was a military leaders & commanders from Jerusalem (b. 1951-09-29, Jerusalem). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to geopolitics.
